query:
FROM logs-system.auth-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= "2026-07-26T19:02:22Z" AND @timestamp < "2026-07-26T20:02:22Z"
        AND host.name == "web-1"
| STATS total = COUNT(*),
        with_outcome = COUNT(*) WHERE event.outcome IS NOT NULL,
        with_message = COUNT(*) WHERE message IS NOT NULL,
        first_seen = MIN(@timestamp),
        last_seen  = MAX(@timestamp)
        BY data_stream.dataset
